method: CPU postprocessing of saved arrays; no field integration or temporal interpolation

F1_reservoir_switching.caption_en: Condensate density after pump turn-on and turn-off in the matched one- and two-reservoir models. PA=1.5 Pth; identical seed and initially empty reservoirs. Time in (b) is measured from pump turn-off at1000 ps. The dotted level is the common stationary density. Saved F1_M0/F1_R1 data from the preceding report are reused.

F2_circular_component_densities.caption_en: Circular-component density profiles with pump imbalance epsilon=0.3, J=beta=0. production_A1_spot: p=13.8, epsilon=0.3, alpha2=-0.00024 meV um^2, J=0 meV, beta=0 meV um^2; N=512, L=256 um, dt=0.025 ps. matched_A1_ring: p=3.3, epsilon=0.3, alpha2=-0.00024 meV um^2, J=0 meV, beta=0 meV um^2; N=512, L=256 um, dt=0.025 ps. production_A1_spot: snapshot at3000 ps, N+=116.277, N-=93.7473, Z=0.107274. matched_A1_ring: snapshot at6000 ps, N+=516.265, N-=241.631, Z=0.362365. A common absolute density scale is used within each geometry. Density stationarity does not imply fixed relative phase. Thin contours mark half-maximum pump; w=d=2.5 um, ring radius10 um.

F3_cross_spin_density_comparison.caption_en: Radial density profiles for alpha2=0 (A0) and alpha2=-0.00024 meV um^2 (A1); all other parameters and preparation are held fixed within each geometry. Small differences have no independent paired convergence bound and are not claimed as a resolved alpha2 effect. Annular snapshots may retain evolving polarization.

F4_TE_TM_spot.caption_en: Densities and circular polarization under Gaussian-spot pumping with TE-TM coupling, at t=3000 ps. production_T0_spot: p=13.8, epsilon=0, alpha2=-0.00024 meV um^2, J=0 meV, beta=0.0119 meV um^2; N=512, L=256 um, dt=0.025 ps. N+=104.912, N-=104.912, Z=5.41141e-14. Both densities share one absolute scale. Thin contours: half-maximum pump; polarization pixels below 0.001 of peak S0 are masked. Density and polarization stationarity were checked on the saved late windows.

F5_TE_TM_ring.caption_en: Densities and circular polarization under annular pumping with TE-TM coupling, at t=6000 ps. matched_T0_ring: p=3.3, epsilon=0, alpha2=-0.00024 meV um^2, J=0 meV, beta=0.0119 meV um^2; N=512, L=256 um, dt=0.025 ps. N+=373.522, N-=382.324, Z=-0.0116459. Both densities share one absolute scale. Thin contours: half-maximum pump; polarization pixels below 0.001 of peak S0 are masked. Densities are stationary within the stated tolerance, while full polarization continues to drift. This is a finite-time snapshot, not a phase-locked state.

F6_TE_TM_angular_response.caption_en: Second angular harmonic Q2=2|C2| versus beta/beta_ref. Markers are time means and vertical bars show the temporal range, not statistical or numerical uncertainty. ROI: r=5-15 um for the spot, r=5-7.5 um for the ring. Each explicitly recorded late window is400 ps; ring T0 is still evolving, so no established monotonic ring response is claimed. The controlled initial seed is shared within each geometry; beta_ref=.0119 meV um^2. The hollow ring marker denotes the evolving beta_ref state at6000 ps. All points use the same Cartesian ROI quadrature; temporal bars do not include its discretization uncertainty. The independent C1 field-convergence controls passed, without providing an error bound for all beta variants.

F7_homogeneous_phase_dynamics.caption_en: Spin imbalance z and change of unwrapped relative phase theta=arg(psi+)-arg(psi-) for independent homogeneous runs at J=.005 and .010 meV, p=2, epsilon=.3, beta=0. Each panel displays the final1200 ps, measured from the start of its own display window; theta0 is the phase at that start. Classification uses two validated windows, not only the displayed segment. Both components remain nonzero. Running and locked phase states survive tighter independent tolerances.

F8_spot_coupling_comparison.caption_en: Angular circular-polarization response under Gaussian pumping, epsilon=.3. A1: J=beta=0; T1: J=0,beta_ref; J1: J_ref,beta=0; C1: J_ref,beta_ref. The cosine angular component2 Re C2 retains the oscillation hidden by the nearly constant modulus Q2. All runs share interval2460-3000 ps; fixed ROI5-15 um. Full-map periodicity is verified.

F8_ring_coupling_comparison.caption_en: Angular circular-polarization response under annular pumping, epsilon=.3. A1: J=beta=0; T1: J=0,beta_ref; J1: J_ref,beta=0; C1: J_ref,beta_ref. Angular s3 is the ratio of integrated S3 and S0 in each of72 polar sectors over r=5-7.5 um. The same Gauss quadrature (32 radial and8 angular nodes per sector) is applied to cubic-interpolated complex fields; a fifth-order cross-check is recorded. This removes unequal Cartesian pixel counts without angular filtering. A1/T1 have periodic observables; J1/C1 are stationary. Each snapshot uses its explicitly recorded physical time and is not phase-aligned across different parameter sets. The four starts share the same explicit seed.

F9_spot_Stokes.caption_en: Gaussian-spot C1 polarization at t=3000 ps. production_C1_spot: p=13.8, epsilon=0.3, alpha2=-0.00024 meV um^2, J=0.01 meV, beta=0.0119 meV um^2; N=512, L=256 um, dt=0.025 ps. S1=2Re(conj(psi+)*psi-), S2=2Im(conj(psi+)*psi-), S3=n+-n-; si=Si/S0. One common [-1,1] scale; low-intensity pixels are masked. Instantaneous phase of a verified periodic state; the accompanying GIF shows its evolution, so this is not a time mean. Independent C1 space/time controls passed.

F10_ring_Stokes.caption_en: Annular-pump C1 polarization at t=3600 ps. matched_C1_ring: p=3.3, epsilon=0.3, alpha2=-0.00024 meV um^2, J=0.01 meV, beta=0.0119 meV um^2; N=512, L=256 um, dt=0.025 ps. S1=2Re(conj(psi+)*psi-), S2=2Im(conj(psi+)*psi-), S3=n+-n-; si=Si/S0. One common [-1,1] scale; low-intensity pixels are masked. Snapshot of the verified stationary polarization. Independent C1 space/time controls passed.
